offices.text: makes a man cunning in all arts, especially rhetoric
procures the loss of prelacies and dignities (prelaturarum et dignitatum iacturam parit)

notes.text: 1904: 'restoreth lost dignities and honours', which contradicts Weyer; Weyer prevails
hoarse voice; flutters about the Circle

goetia.textus: (24.) Naberius. —The Twenty-fourth Spirit is Naberius. He is a most valiant Marquis, and showeth in the form of a Black Crane, fluttering about the Circle, and when he speaketh it is with a hoarse voice. He maketh men cunning in all Arts and Sciences, but especially in the Art of Rhetoric. He restoreth lost Dignities and Honours. He governeth 19 Legions of Spirits. His Seal is this, which is to be worn, etc.
forma: He is a most valiant Marquis, and showeth in the form of a Black Crane, fluttering about the Circle, and when he speaketh it is with a hoarse voice.

hostilitas: malice: procures the loss of dignities
reticentia: the witnesses are silent on his truthfulness
